description: Update the Japanese README.md to document the three new JWT-authorized admin routes (GET/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/quizzes/{quizId}), the full-replace edit semantics, and the tightened CORS (allowOrigins now the specific Amplify domain, PUT/DELETE added to allowMethods) including how to override the allowed origin per-deploy. Depends on FEAT-001 having defined the exact routes/behavior.
steps: README.md: In the ASCII route list around lines 40-46 (under 'API Gateway HTTP API (v2)'), add the three new admin routes beneath the existing 'POST /api/admin/quizzes' entry, marking them 管理者のみ / JWT オーソライザー: 'GET /api/admin/quizzes/{quizId}' (管理者用・正解 answerIndex を含めて返す = 編集フォーム用), 'PUT /api/admin/quizzes/{quizId}' (管理者のみ・全置換で更新), 'DELETE /api/admin/quizzes/{quizId}' (管理者のみ・削除). Keep the existing formatting style.

README.md: Add a short subsection describing the admin edit/delete behavior in Japanese: 編集は全置換方式 (既存の Q#n をすべて削除してから META + 新しい Q#n を書き込む; quizId はパスから取得し新規採番しない; 存在しない quizId は 404); 削除は META と全 Q#n を削除 (存在しない場合は 404); 管理者用 GET は公開用 GET と異なり answerIndex を含めて返す (編集フォームの正解プリフィル用)。これら3ルートは既存の POST /api/admin/quizzes と同じ Cognito JWT オーソライザーで保護され、公開ルートは変更なし。

README.md: Update the CORS bullets around lines 57-63. Change allowMethods to list GET / POST / PUT / DELETE / OPTIONS. Change the allowOrigins description: no longer '*'; it is now limited to the Amplify domain https://main.d2uwsqpk41y7so.amplifyapp.com by default, and is configurable per-deploy via the `allowedOrigin` override (document the exact command, matching what FEAT-001 implemented, e.g. `npx cdk deploy -c allowedOrigin=https://your-domain.example`). Mention that the Lambda response header access-control-allow-origin is set to the same configured origin (via the ALLOWED_ORIGIN env var) so CORS is tightened end-to-end.

README.md: If there is a later section that previously said to tighten allowOrigins '後述' / 'once known', update or remove that now-stale note so the doc is internally consistent (CORS is now tightened by default).
acceptance_criteria: README documents all three new admin routes with their auth (JWT) and semantics (full-replace edit, delete, answerIndex-inclusive admin read).
README CORS section lists GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/OPTIONS and states allowOrigins is the specific Amplify domain by default, configurable via the allowedOrigin override with the exact command shown.
README mentions the Lambda response header is tightened to the same origin via ALLOWED_ORIGIN, and any prior 'tighten later' note is reconciled.
Documentation remains in Japanese, consistent with the existing README style; no em dashes used.
verification: Read-based: confirm README route list and CORS section match exactly what FEAT-001 implemented (route paths/methods, default origin literal, override command, env var name).
findings: Docs-only change; no build/test run (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox). Verified README against FEAT-001 source: routes in lib/quiz-app-stack.ts (POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/quizzes[/{quizId}]), default allowedOrigin literal 'https://main.d2uwsqpk41y7so.amplifyapp.com', override command 'npx cdk deploy -c allowedOrigin=...', ALLOWED_ORIGIN env var and access-control-allow-origin header in lambda/index.ts, and allowMethods GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/OPTIONS. Also reconciled the stale test-description route count (now 7 routes = public 3 + admin 4) and removed the now-obsolete 'tighten CORS later' follow-up bullet.
